name: Trivy Open Source Security Scanner
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source scanner for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets and software bills of materials across container images, code repositories, filesystems and Kubernetes, with no software-imposed scan quota.
watch_out: Requires your own compute, network access and vulnerability database updates; scanning results depend on available advisory data and require human triage. Hosted security services and optional integrations may be separately priced.
